sources.snippet: Rover AI Model — Body Part Detector A live-camera prototype for search-and-rescue (SAR) applications: detects people in a video feed and draws a labeled bounding box around each visible body part (head, arms, hands, torso, legs), built on top of a pretrained YOLO pose-estimation model.
